meta.actionEn: An anthelmintic (deworming) medicine that treats roundworm, pinworm, whipworm, and hookworm infections.

1dc4154e.symEn: Treatment of roundworm, pinworm, whipworm, and hookworm infections, and mixed infections of these
1dc4154e.pointEn: A deworming medicine for roundworm, pinworm, whipworm, and hookworm infections.

caef296c.watchKo: 과민증, 임부, 갈락토오스 불내성 등 유전적 문제 환자 복용 금지
caef296c.watchEn: Do not use with hypersensitivity, if pregnant, or with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance

en.1dc4154e: This medicine is used to treat infections of roundworms (Ascaris), pinworms, whipworms, and hookworms, and mixed infections of these.
en.9bd5f279: Adults and children take 1 tablet (500 mg) as a single 1-time dose.
en.caef296c: Do not take this medicine if you are hypersensitive to it, are pregnant, or have hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption.
en.85e1161b: Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the patient is an infant under 1 year of age, or you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding.
en.1b6d5cec: In rare cases, if transient nausea, abdominal pain, diarrhea, rash, hives, or angioedema occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
